faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Collector Office Gadchiroli Kendra Chalak recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your offline application for the Kendra Chalak posts is 07-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Kendra Chalak post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed HSC (12th grade) and possess basic computer knowledge, with MSCIT being preferred. This ensures a foundational understanding of computer operations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 18 years. There is no upper age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Kendra Chalak position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 8000. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Kendra Chalak post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies for the Kendra Chalak position announced by the Collector Office Gadchiroli.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Kendra Chalak posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a structured interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Collector Office Gadchiroli, which is www.gadchiroli.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Kendra Chalak posts is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the contract terms.
